title: Joe Phillips
description: Once again, "It's not wise to upset a Wookiee." Riled because he's lost a holoboard game, Chewie "disarms" a droid in this imaginary scene. "To me, STAR WARS is about friendship," adds Joe Phillips. "Han Solo and Chewbacca are a classic example of two people from different backgrounds uniting for a common cause in the name of friendship." It was Phillips' brother, Bernard, who got him interested in comics back in the mid-'80s. Since then he's drawn over fifty issues: "Everything from SPEED RACER, MISTER MIRACLE and TIMBERWOLF to SILVER SURFER, THE INCREDIBLE HULK and my new series, QUANTUM 5, due out this summer."
